say:3:1410833402:1.text: No wonder it was weaker than the rumored Hypogeans.
say:3:1410833402:1.source_cn: 怪不得，它比传闻中的恶魔弱小，不堪一击。

say:4:1410833403:1.text: Is that why Indris sensed dark energy around it when we last came here?
say:4:1410833403:1.source_cn: 既然已经消灭了魔物，还能感觉到那种诡异的气息吗？

say:5:1410833404:1.text: There's still a bit of tainted magic left on the bow. I'm afraid it won't be so easy to get rid of.
say:5:1410833404:1.source_cn: 神弓上仍然残留了一丝肮脏的魔力，恐怕没那么容易消除。

say:6:1410833405:1.text: That stone sucking Eldric! How the heck did he let Eclipsion get corrupted?! It's the holy relic of Helthor!
say:6:1410833405:1.source_cn: 白痴弗林！它到底是怎么保管杜恩加尔的？竟然让脏东西玷污...

say:7:1410833406:1.text: You can't rule out that the Eclipsion was corrupted long ago. Eldric might've never known.
say:7:1410833406:1.source_cn: 不排除杜恩加尔早已被魔物寄宿，只是弗林感受不到，所以一...
